description: Withdraw MEV. Calls only POST /v4/wallets/util/withdraw-mev and returns an unsigned transaction for the user to sign. This tool does not sign, submit, or broadcast, and it does not accept a private key. Solana API endpoint for withdrawing MEV rewards on Solana. Build a transaction to claim accumulated MEV rewards from staking positions like Jito.

body.description: Request payload model for withdraw mev param parameters used by this API endpoint.

gasless.description: Use Vybe fee payer for gas

mevFee.description: Fee percentage on withdrawn MEV (0-1, e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

ownerAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields.

router.description: Router for vybesol conversion (if vybesol is true)

stakeAccountAddresses.description: Specific stake account addresses to close (auto-fetches if not provided)

name: build-withdraw-mev
title: Withdraw MEV
